import primitive_api as api

task_ctx = api.get_task_context()
print("Task Context:", task_ctx)

obs = api.observe()
print("Pose:", obs.get("agent_pose"))
print("Visible objects:", [o.get("objectType") for o in obs.get("visible_objects", [])])
print("Inventory:", obs.get("inventory"))

progress = api.check_progress_public()

# Let's check objects near the sink or in the room
# We can locate the SoapBar using pickup_located_object or locate_object

print("Locate SoapBar:", res.get("found"), res.get("visible_now"))
if res.get("candidates"):
    for c in res["candidates"]:
        print("Candidate:", c.get("objectId"), c.get("objectType"), c.get("distance"))
